specification.allocation_peak_scope: Separate tracemalloc peak for each complete solve plus JSON serialization at 10 iterations/delay 5; verify original-world metrics after tracing. Python-traced allocations only, not RSS or high-iteration memory.
specification.interpretation: Candidate replaces only the delayed adapter's imported strategy alias with direct normalization of its CFR+-clamped nonnegative regret rows. Exact output equality and quality checks are mandatory. Timing is a three-pair whole-call comparison; promotion requires at least a 5% median reduction. Any changed loop or allocation accounting requires a separate public-vector admission review.
specification.model_limits: Same fixed weighted fixture as the prior profile: finite conditioned heads-up preflop/flop-checkdown game, three exact private combos per player, two selected flops and 27,720 physical worlds; one shared 10-chip stack; forced checkdown after flop betting. Not broad-range/full-deck, all-streets, multiway, unrestricted NLHE, or a general convergence claim.
specification.promotion_gate_rule: Exact payload parity and quality target on every timing arm; candidate faster in all three paired runs; median reduction at least 5%; separate candidate traced peak no more than 1.01 times baseline. The traced-peak condition is only a nonregression gate, not evidence of an RSS or general memory gain.

normalization_self_check.scope: nonnegative inputs only; negative-regret behavior is outside the CFR+ invariant

normalization_work_accounting: For each rematched row, shared strategy allocates and clamps a positive list, sums it, then constructs normalized output; the candidate sums the already nonnegative row and constructs normalized output. This removes one clamp pass and temporary row allocation, adds no persistent state, and does not exceed the existing conservative row-loop budget. No budget is reduced.
admission_scope: Same existing public-vector model and requested iteration budgets in both arms. The direct normalization removes the shared max-clamp traversal only inside the preflop adapter alias; it adds no persistent per-row state. This does not relax or revise vector-budget accounting.
interpretation: Exact serialized payload parity and independent original-world replay are mandatory. A 5% median gate is required before considering promotion; this experiment alone does not establish general speedup or solver accuracy beyond this finite fixture. Traced peaks are Python allocations for the separate 10-iteration calls, not RSS or high-iteration memory.
model_limits: Same fixed weighted fixture as the prior profile: finite conditioned heads-up preflop/flop-checkdown game, three exact private combos per player, two selected flops and 27,720 physical worlds; one shared 10-chip stack; forced checkdown after flop betting. Not broad-range/full-deck, all-streets, multiway, unrestricted NLHE, or a general convergence claim.
